title: Pan-Seared Fish with Lemon
description: A simple and flavorful dish that showcases the freshness of seafood. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
In a skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes.
While the fish is cooking, squeeze the lemon juice over the top and sprinkle with parsley.
Remove the skillet from the oven and serve the fish hot.
Serve with additional lemon wedges and parsley, if desired.
